row.notes: Reads one track_data.track_layers row (TrackLayer, 0x28 bytes) into rcx from the database row reader rdx and returns rcx. It first calls the base reader 0x142a0ddb0 (r8b 1, r9 0; 11 callers, this one at 0x142e58803), which zeroes +0x0..+0xb and, unless the row's is_invalid is set (0x142a0de07), fills three masks: +0x0 setup modes, one bit per listed game_setup.game_setup_modes row at its stat_id (0x142a0dfbe); +0x4 seasons, one bit per listed game_setup.seasons row at its statId (0x142a0e20e); an absent id sets bit 0 and an id of 32 or more calls the bitset range failure 0x1411c04f0 (0x142a0e025, 0x142a0e292); +0x8 weekend formats, written once at 0x142a0e495: bit 1 for a listed format whose lower-cased name hashes (FNV-1a 64, 0x0b4d8c10d825b055) like sprint, bit 0 for any other or an unnamed one. Then the row's own fields: statId as a u8 -> +0xc (0x142e58826, 0 when absent); the row key, decoded in place from the string object of 0x1445a3900, -> +0x10 as a char * (0x142e58904); the field slot pointers of worldAssetGroup -> +0x18 (0x142e5891a) and worldEri -> +0x20 (0x142e58930), which Game_TrackLayer_BuildExtraWorldDesc expands later. Callers: Sess_Load_TrackDatabase 0x142e5bd03 (at the vector end) and 0x142e5bdc4 (after growing the vector by half), one row per database row in database order, into the TrackDataSystem vector begin +0x1e0, end +0x1e8, capacity +0x1f0, allocator +0x1d8, stride 0x28; Trk_TrackData_CollectLayersForQuery reads the three masks. Steam 1.0.145 (sigport --witness): this function 0x142e5ad70 118/118 with +0xc, +0x10, +0x18 and +0x20 at the same instructions, the base reader 0x142a10170 450/450 with +0x4 and +0x8, Sess_Load_TrackDatabase 0x142e5b4b0 4530/4530 with +0x1d8, +0x1e0, +0x1e8 and +0x1f0. | 2026-11-17 engine-re raised it to L2 with --force at user request (lane owner review requested). | re-bindings 2026-11-18: the masks, the table and the 1.0.145 witness.
